text: Marta (Marketing): Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before next week Marta (Marketing): Need: hero variants, a compact benchmark narrative we can surface on hero or just below, a webinar CTA (short), and inbound lead routing rules for demo vs enterprise requests. Sam (Growth): +1. My priority is clarity for self-serve vs enterprise. Two CTAs: "Try Hosted API (self-serve)" and "Request Dedicated / Private demo". Keep one-liner for hero under 12 words. Leo (Product): For benchmark placement: put a short stat block right under the hero and link to the full benchmark page. Suggested copy: "1.2M tokens/sec peak serving, 30% lower per-token cost vs baseline — production-profiled on public workloads." (we can strip strong tags for site) Anya (UX): Headline options (choose 1): - "Predictable LLM inference at production scale" - "Ship LLM features with consistent latency and cost" Subhead (short): "Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — same API, production SLAs." Microcopy for CTAs: "Start free with Hosted" / "Book a Dedicated demo" Marta (Marketing): Love the headline 1 and the stat block. Can we pare down the benchmark line to one crisp sentence for the hero area? Maybe: "Production-profiled — up to 1.2M tokens/sec and 30% lower per-token cost." Priya (Growth Ops): Routing rules draft for inbound forms / webinar signups: - If selected "Enterprise / Dedicated / Private" OR company size > 250 employees => route to #leads-enterprise and create Salesforce lead w/ Tier = Enterprise. - If selected "Hosted API / Try Hosted" and company size <= 250 => route to #leads-self-serve and tag utm_campaign=hosted-try. - Webinar registrants: tag "webinar:launch-2"; if company size > 100 => add follow-up task for AE. - Form fields to require: Company, Company size (dropdown), Use case (short), Consent to contact (checkbox). - Slack webhook: POST to /hooks/lead-router with payload {"channel":"#leads-enterprise","priority":"high"} for enterprise. (Ops will hide endpoint). Sam (Growth): Can we also add a quick gating rule: if email domain is major cloud provider or competitor => manual review, route to #growth-review. Anya (UX): A/B idea for hero: Variant A = stat-first (trust); Variant B = value-first (what you build). Keep CTA copy identical for clean signal. Marta (Marketing): Webinar copy snippet (30 chars max for hero CTA): "Join launch webinar — live demos". Below-hero CTA copy: "See Hosted, Dedicated, and Private in action — register for a 45-min walkthrough and Q&A." Leo (Product): For the Dedicated page hero variant, add sentence: "Reserved GPU pools, configurable autoscale, SLA-backed latency targets." For Private: "VPC-ready, on-prem option, KMS/HSM integrations." Keep bullets 1 line each. Priya (Growth Ops): Implementation notes for web team: - Map form field "Deployment interest" to dropdown values: hosted,dedicated,private. - UTM mapping: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign -> saved on lead record. - Webhook payload keys: email,name,company,size,use_case,deployment_interest,utm. - Create two lead queues in Salesforce: Self-Serve and Enterprise-Dedicated. deploy-bot: "Reminder: marketing-site branch must be merged by EOD Thu to hit next-week launch window. CI status: 2 failing tests." :warning: Marta (Marketing): Ok team — action items: - Anya: finalize hero A/B copy and microcopy by EOD Wed. - Leo: confirm benchmark short sentence and Dedicated/Private bullets. - Priya: implement routing webhook spec + create SF queues. - Sam: write the webinar email series 1-pager and quick A/B plan. Marta (Marketing): If no objections, I'll lock the copy variant A (stat-first) tomorrow morning and push to staging. @Sam @Anya @Priya please thumbs up or drop adjustments. :thumbsup: Sam (Growth): 👍 will review email series by 11am tomorrow. Anya (UX): 👍 working on variants now. Priya (Growth Ops): 👍 starting webhook spec doc. Marta (Marketing): Thanks — will post the staging URL in this thread once deployed.
